summary: Iteration 12 - Stripchat Cams Integration & HLS Proxy Testing Complete. All 17 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified: Live page shows 2 sections (internal creator lives + external cams), 4 gender tabs, cam cards with proper structure, CamRoom with HLS player and Stripchat attribution (TEXT only, no link). NO outbound links to stripchat.com found in frontend code.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/cams?limit=N&gender=X returns {total, count, items} with proxied HLS URLs starting with /api/hls/
GET /api/cams/{username} returns single cam or 404 for offline/non-existent models
GET /api/hls/{b64url} proxies upstream m3u8 manifests with CORS header ACAO=*, rewrites segment URIs to /api/hls/... paths
GET /api/hls/{b64url} returns 400 for invalid base64, 403 for non-whitelisted hosts
HLS proxy correctly rewrites EXT-X-MAP URI attributes for init segments
25s cache working - two quick calls return consistent cached results
Frontend /live page shows 2 sections: internal creator lives (top) + 'Cams en direct' (below) with 4 gender tabs
Cam cards display: thumb, LIVE badge, viewers count (k suffix), HD badge, username, country/gender
Click on cam card navigates to /live/cam/{username}
CamRoom shows: HlsPlayer with aspect-video, side panel with username, viewer count (fr-FR formatted), languages, description
'Retour aux lives' button navigates back to /live
HlsPlayer has mute/fullscreen controls, 'Stripchat' attribution badge (TEXT only, not a link)
HlsPlayer shows 'Lecteur non supporté' in headless (expected - H.264 codec limitation)
NO outbound links/redirects to stripchat.com anywhere in frontend code (verified via grep)
Route /live/cam/:username correctly maps to CamRoom in App.js

test_credentials.note: No auth required for /api/cams* and /api/hls* endpoints
